title: Michael & Zion Revenue Group
description: A freelance B2B sales development agency that I founded and built, providing businesses with targeted outreach, lead generation, and sales growth strategies.
detailedDescription: Michael & Zion Revenue Group is a freelance sales development agency created to help businesses generate new opportunities through personalized outreach, prospect research, lead qualification, and relationship-driven sales strategies. I designed and developed the agency's digital presence, including brand identity, website, messaging, and client-facing materials, while also managing sales operations and outreach campaigns. The agency combines business development, digital branding, web development, and customer acquisition strategy to help organizations build stronger sales pipelines.
